messages.text: Will a power spike fry the whole miner?

Great question — this is actually one of the Rev 6.1's real design wins.

**The onboard F1 fuse takes the hit, not the miner.**

There's a small automotive-style blade fuse — the **F1 fuse, right on the board next to the yellow XT30 power connector** — that acts as the first line of defense. A spike blows that fuse, protecting everything behind it.

- Cheaper miners often omit this entirely — a spike goes straight into the electronics
- Here, a **$0.50 sacrificial part** dies instead of your miner
- Replace the fuse, back in business

The fuse is **on the miner board itself** (not in the PSU or on the cable) — so the protection is right at the door where power enters the circuit.
